title: Codonopsis Radix Inhibits the Inflammatory Response and Oxidative Stress in Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease Mice through Regulation of the Nrf2/NF-kappaB Signaling Pathway.
authors: Chen, Zhengjun; Shi, Qi; Liu, Xuxia; Lu, Guodi; Yang, Jie; Luo, Wenrong; Yang, Fude
one_liner_zh: 该文研究党参对COPD小鼠的抗炎抗氧化作用，涉及Nrf2/NF-kappaB通路，但无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a nonspecific chronic inflammatory lung disease with no known cure. Codonopsis Radix (CR) has been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. Therefore, this study aimed to investigate the potential anti-inflammatory effects of different CR varieties on COPD mice. METHODS: Sixty male-specified pathogen-free grade C57BL/6J mice were randomly divided into 6 groups, 10 mice in each group. The COPD mice model was induced by cigarette smoke extract combined with lipopolysaccharide, and the mice in each group were given corresponding drugs. Lung function was assessed in all mice. Lung tissues were stained with hematoxylin-eosin, Masson, and periodic acid-Schiff stains, and serum levels of interleukin (IL)-8 and tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-alpha were detected using an ELISA. Further, serum and lung tissue levels of malondialdehyde (MDA) and superoxide dismutase (SOD) were detected by colorimetric assay. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to predict signaling pathways, which were validated by Western blot analysis. RESULTS: Compared with the COPD group, the mice in each dosing group of CR exhibited significant reductions in serum IL-8 and TNF-alpha levels, serum and lung tissue MDA levels, and pathological lung tissue damage, alongside elevations in lung function and SOD levels (p < 0.01). Western blot analysis also indicated significant downregulation of p-p65/p65 and p-IkappaB-alpha/IkappaB-alpha protein expression, alongside significant upregulation of Nrf2 protein expression in the lung tissues of mice treated with CR (p < 0.01). CONCLUSION: In summary, CR effectively enhances lung function, minimizes lung tissue damage, and inhibits inflammation and oxidative stress in mice with COPD. Additionally, these findings suggest that inhibition of the Nrf2/NF-kappaB axis may be a key mechanism of action of CR in the alleviation of COPD.
abstract_zh: 引言：慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）是一种无已知治愈方法的非特异性慢性炎症性肺部疾病。党参（Codonopsis Radix, CR）已被证明具有抗炎和抗氧化作用。因此，本研究旨在探讨不同品种党参对COPD小鼠的潜在抗炎作用。方法：将60只雄性无特定病原体级C57BL/6J小鼠随机分为6组，每组10只。通过香烟烟雾提取物联合脂多糖诱导COPD小鼠模型，各组小鼠给予相应药物。评估所有小鼠的肺功能。肺组织分别用苏木精-伊红、Masson和过碘酸-雪夫染色，并使用ELISA检测血清中白细胞介素（IL）-8和肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）-α水平。进一步，通过比色法检测血清和肺组织中丙二醛（MDA）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）水平。采用网络药理学和分子对接预测信号通路，并通过Western blot分析进行验证。结果：与COPD组相比，各党参给药组小鼠血清IL-8和TNF-α水平、血清和肺组织MDA水平以及肺组织病理损伤均显著降低，同时肺功能和SOD水平显著升高（p < 0.01）。Western blot分析还表明，党参处理小鼠肺组织中p-p65/p65和p-IκB-α/IκB-α蛋白表达显著下调，而Nrf2蛋白表达显著上调（p < 0.01）。结论：总之，党参有效增强COPD小鼠的肺功能，减少肺组织损伤，并抑制炎症和氧化应激。此外，这些发现提示抑制Nrf2/NF-κB轴可能是党参缓解COPD的关键作用机制。
